description: Kill the client-driven 'Server slow' toast and make logout instant. Add a `silent` request flag to api() that suppresses the global toast and disables the GET auto-retry for polled/silent calls; mark all background polls (staff 7s, rider 12s, track 8s) silent so a dropped poll never raises the toast while foreground user-initiated loads keep normal error toasts; bound the admin screenshot raw fetch with a ~15s AbortController so its card can never spin forever; reorder auth.logout() to clear the local session FIRST and fire network calls fire-and-forget. Covers plan.md items 1,2,3,10. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: src/api.ts: add `silent?: boolean` to RequestOpts. Extend ApiError with an optional `silent` property. In api(): keep the 15s AbortController timeout AND the single GET auto-retry for NON-silent calls exactly as today; when opts.silent is true, do NOT auto-retry on timeout/network error (skip the `method==='GET' && !opts._netRetried` recursion) and throw an ApiError with silent=true so the toast surface can skip it. Thread `silent` through all internal recursions (_retried, _netRetried, and the 401-refresh retry) so the flag is preserved. Ensure api.get/api.post still work; allow passing opts (e.g. api('/orders',{method:'GET',silent:true}).

src/queries.ts: in useAllOrders change the queryFn to call api('/orders',{method:'GET',silent:true}); set retry:false on this polled query so a dropped poll fails once quietly and the next interval refetches. Keep useMyOrders, useOrder, usePage, useProducts, useCategories, useSettings NON-silent (foreground). Do NOT add a blanket global onError that toasts every query error; the single toast surface must inspect err.silent (from step 1) and skip silent failures.
app/track/[orderId].tsx: make the 8s track poll's API call silent:true (edit the query fn in this screen). Do NOT change the polling interval or the tracking data shape or TrackMap.

app/rider.tsx: ensure the 12s rider poll uses useAllOrders (already silent after step 2) OR, if it calls the API directly, pass silent:true. Do NOT change the rider flow, /orders/accept, or /tracking/* usage.

app/admin/order/[id].tsx (useScreenshot ONLY): wrap the raw fetch(apiUrl('/orders/:id/screenshot')) in a new AbortController() with setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),15000) and clearTimeout in finally; pass controller.signal to fetch. On abort/network error keep throwing new Error('none') so react-query (retry:false) resolves to shot.data==null and the existing '⚠️ No payment screenshot found' empty state renders and the ActivityIndicator stops. Do NOT route this through api(); do NOT touch anything else in this file in this feature.

src/store/auth.ts (logout): reorder to clear local session FIRST and synchronously: setAccessToken(null) and set({ user:null }), then return immediately. Fire unregisterPush().catch(()=>null), api.post('/users/logout',{refreshToken}) ideally with silent:true .catch(()=>null), and clearRefreshToken().catch(()=>null) in the background (not awaited). Read the refresh token before/inside the background block. Preserve offline-safe logout (local clear must not depend on the network). Do NOT add cart-clearing behavior that is not already there.
acceptance_criteria: cd 4astore-v2/mobile; npx tsc --noEmit prints ONLY the known app.config.ts(39) TS2353 usesCleartextTraffic error (no new errors).

api() rejects quietly (no global toast) for silent calls on timeout/network failure and does NOT auto-retry silent GETs; non-silent foreground GETs still get the 15s timeout and ONE auto-retry and still surface the toast.
useAllOrders (staff 7s / rider 12s) and the track 8s poll call the API with silent:true; useMyOrders/useOrder/usePage/login/checkout remain non-silent.
useScreenshot has an AbortController ~15s + clearTimeout; a failed/slow screenshot yields the no-screenshot empty state and the indicator stops (bounded).
auth.logout() clears local session before any await and fires the network calls fire-and-forget with .catch(()=>null); offline logout still works.
setStatus in admin/order/[id].tsx is unchanged; tracking/rider/payments data shapes and intervals unchanged.
verification: cd c:/xampp/htdocs/static4a/.worktrees/app-slow-loaders-login/4astore-v2/mobile; npm install; npx tsc --noEmit  (expect ONLY the app.config.ts usesCleartextTraffic error)
Read src/api.ts and confirm the silent flag path: no auto-retry for silent, flag threaded through recursions, ApiError carries silent.
Read src/queries.ts, app/track/[orderId].tsx, app/rider.tsx and confirm polls are silent and foreground queries are not.
Read useScreenshot and logout and confirm the timeout and the local-first reorder.
findings:
DONE. Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit` in 4astore-v2/mobile prints ONLY the known app.config.ts(39) TS2353 usesCleartextTraffic error (no new errors).

SILENT-FLAG SHAPE (src/api.ts): RequestOpts now has `silent?: boolean`. ApiError constructor is now `constructor(message, status, silent?)` and carries a public optional `silent?: boolean` field. A silent GET does NOT auto-retry (the `method==='GET' && !_netRetried` recursion is additionally guarded by `!opts.silent`); on timeout/network failure it throws `new ApiError(msg, 0, opts.silent)`. The 401-session-expired throw and the generic `Request failed`/`success:false` throw also pass `opts.silent` through. `silent` is threaded through BOTH internal recursions automatically because they spread `{ ...opts, _netRetried/_retried: true }`.

HOW A TOAST SURFACE SHOULD READ IT: there is NO central QueryCache onError in this app — errors are surfaced per-screen (e.g. `showToast(apiError(e),'error')` in rider.tsx/roles.tsx; inline `apiError(q.error)` text in track/order screens). A later feature adding any global error->toast surface MUST skip errors where `(e instanceof ApiError) && e.silent === true`. For the silent polls specifically, retry:false + silent means the dropped poll never auto-retries and the ApiError it throws is flagged silent.

CALL SITES CHANGED TO SILENT: useAllOrders (staff 7s / rider 12s) now calls `api('/orders',{method:'GET',silent:true})` with `retry:false`. track/[orderId].tsx 8s poll now calls `api('/tracking',{method:'GET',params:{orderId},silent:true})`. rider.tsx already uses useAllOrders so it inherits silent (no direct poll there). auth.logout() posts `/users/logout` with `{method:'POST',...,silent:true}`.

NON-SILENT (foreground) LEFT AS-IS: useMyOrders, useOrder, usePage, useProducts, useCategories, useSettings, useConfig, login/register/checkout — all keep normal retry + toast. api.get/api.post helpers are UNCHANGED (silent calls use the direct api(path,opts) form).

LOGOUT (src/store/auth.ts): now clears local session FIRST and synchronously (setAccessToken(null); set({user:null})) then returns; the refresh-token read, unregisterPush(), /users/logout POST (silent) and clearRefreshToken() all run in a non-awaited background IIFE with .catch(()=>null). Offline logout still works.

SCREENSHOT (app/admin/order/[id].tsx useScreenshot ONLY): raw fetch now wrapped in `new AbortController()` with `setTimeout(abort,15000)` + `clearTimeout` in finally and `signal` passed to fetch; any abort/error throws `new Error('none')` so (retry:false) yields shot.data==null and the existing '⚠️ No payment screenshot found' empty state renders and the ActivityIndicator stops. setStatus() in this file is UNCHANGED (still optimistic cache update + rollback+toast, no button spinner). Tracking/rider/payments data shapes and poll intervals unchanged.
